messages:
elaine: Heads up — saw a big Dedicated pool hit from rehydrate jobs during EU night shift, pushed some prod traffic into fallback models.
kevin: I noticed higher p95 and a couple of user reports. quick figure: ~20% of dedicated GPU slots used by rehydrates between 02:00-03:30 UTC.
alex: can you drop the query you ran? want to cross-check with autoscaler events.
elaine: yup, I pulled:
```
SELECT job_id, tenant, cohort, start_ts, sum(gpu_seconds) as gpu_s
FROM telemetry.rehydrate_jobs
WHERE start_ts >= '2026-03-18T00:00:00Z' AND start_ts < '2026-03-19T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY gpu_s DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
maria: looks like a bunch of those were kicked from the console (manual runs). did someone mass-launch from the UI? :thinking:
jun: ops-bot shows three console triggers around 02:05-02:12 UTC from @ops-runner and @solutions-eng — probably someone trying to clear late windows.
ops-bot: job 84299 started (rehydrate, cohort=eu-prod, priority=low) — triggered by console UI. (reaction :eyes:)
elaine: core issue: low-priority rehydrates default to Dedicated when idle. acceptable during deep idle, but on uneven traffic they don't preempt fast enough.
sam: can we route low-priority rehydrates to hosted by default and keep Dedicated for high-SLA requests only?
kevin: routing logic is in the scheduler. currently we tag tasks as `batch` and scheduler places them on any idle slot. we need a policy layer to prefer pool labelled `shared-hosted` for low priority.
alex: small runner-side tweak: before claiming a dedicated slot, check `pct_used_reserved_pool > 0.6` then fallback to hosted. cheap and fast to ship.
maria: Console UX idea: when launching a rehydrate, show "Run target" (dedicated | hosted) and default to hosted for roles without `dedicated-run` permission. also show GPU estimate.
jun: agree + also show estimated `gpu_seconds` and expected runtime. users currently have no cost signal.
elaine: we also saw duplicate rehydrates — dedupe TTL is too short so overlapping windows spawn parallel jobs.
kevin: dedupe key should be `tenant:cohort:day-window`. extend TTL to 48h for EU and 36h for US to account for late-arriving events.
sam: incremental canary: launch 1-2% of rehydrate workload into Dedicated as a canary, hold remainder on hosted, only ramp if slack capacity remains. prevents sudden capacity grabs.
alex: I'll add a `canary_pct` field to the job proto and implement ramping in the runner. need a console flag to opt-in for now.
maria: ops needs better observability: add console logs when a run flips target pool and include the `gpu_seconds` estimate and the dedupe key in event payloads.
jun: I'll update ops-bot to log trigger metadata: who clicked, target pool, estimated gpu_seconds, dedupe_key.
ops-bot: recorded trigger by @ops-runner — target=hosted, estimate=12k gpu_seconds, dedupe_key=tenantA:eu:2026-03-16. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
elaine: proposed action list:
- Console: default target -> hosted for low-priority, show gpu_seconds
- Runner: gate dedicated claims when reserved_pool_usage > 60%
- Data: extend dedupe TTL for late windows
- Scheduler: add `preferred_pool` attribute on job proto
- Canaries: implement `canary_pct` ramping
I'll write a short RFC and owners.
kevin: I'll bring a rollback plan and quick patch to gate dedicated claims. ETA: today for patch, next-week for full scheduler change.
alex: prototyping runner gate + canary flag today, can have a small test in staging by EOD.
maria: will spec the console changes and permission toggle. UX copy: "Run in Dedicated GPUs (incurs reserved capacity)" with warning tooltip.
jun: ops-bot will surface trigger events to #eng-platform as INFO and include the target pool and estimate.
sam: we should also add a quota check: disallow launching > X gpu_seconds in Dedicated per team per 24h unless approved. prevents accidental bursts.
elaine: good idea. add quota soft-limits with an override flow.
ops-bot: meeting created — "rehydrate routing + console UX" 15:00 UTC today. link: https://meet/def456
kevin: will attend, bringing metrics dashboards and sample logs.
alex: will demo runner canary proto in staging.
maria: thanks all. small UX + runner changes should cut accidental Dedicated consumption significantly. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks — see you at 15:00. (reaction :rocket:)
